component.name: System4Dispatch
component.summary: OpenLCB / LCC dispatch panel and throttle

description.p: A dispatcher's panel and throttle for model railroads that use OpenLCB / LCC. Draw your track diagram, watch block occupancy live, throw turnouts with a tap, and run trains through an LCC command station.
Connects with a GridConnect USB adapter or over the network to JMRI, an Ethernet LCC buffer or rolcb-hub. A built-in simulator lets you try everything without hardware.
